keyword.en: what voltage does the concrete pump catalogue print
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵目录印了多少伏

title.en: Concrete Pump Prints a Rated Voltage: 380 V beside the Shotcrete article
title.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了额定电压：对照「Shotcrete」时，380 V仍在原页

description.en: Concrete Pump Prints a Rated Voltage. 380 V stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Shotcrete.
description.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了额定电压。380 V仍在目录格子里。插图来自「Shotcrete」。

h1.en: Concrete Pump Prints a Rated Voltage: 380 V beside the Shotcrete article
h1.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了额定电压：对照「Shotcrete」时，380 V仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a rated voltage on one concrete pump in the Xingtai catalogue: B500S-83D, 380 V, beside a 7.5 kW motor. Electric 10, Electric 15, Electric 20, Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 list motor kilowatts and do not list volts or frequency. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵目录里只给一台机器标出了额定电压：B500S-83D 为 380 V，旁边是 7.5 kW 电机。电动10、电动15、电动20、电动40、电动60和电动80标出电机千瓦，不标出伏特或频率。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete. The picture shows Shotcrete. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a rated voltage on one concrete pump in the Xingtai catalogue: B500S-83D, 380 V, beside a 7.5 kW motor. B500S-83D's type line says two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Hebei Pinjin Machinery gives this concrete pump its own page in Xingtai. Spraying-machine pages that list 380 V are not concrete pump rows and do not fill this gap.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete。画面是Shotcrete。河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵目录里只给一台机器标出了额定电压：B500S-83D 为 380 V，旁边是 7.5 kW 电机。电动10标出 15 kW，没有电压，尽管它和 B500S-83D 一样是紧凑电动设备。

body.en: Electric 10, Electric 15, Electric 20, Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 list motor kilowatts and do not list volts or frequency. The rated-voltage entry is 380 V. Electric 80 lists 110 kW and no voltage. The contact page asks for site voltage and frequency when you inquire.
body.zh: 电动10、电动15、电动20、电动40、电动60和电动80标出电机千瓦，不标出伏特或频率。喷涂机页面上的 380 V 不是混凝土泵行，也不能填这个空。

body.en: Do not copy 380 V onto those pages. The motor-power entry is 7.5 kW. Electric 10 lists 15 kW and no voltage, even though it is a compact electric machine like B500S-83D. That request does not invent a voltage on the pump sheet.
body.zh: B500S-83D 的型式行写两级结构泵，手动/电动。请通过 /zh/contact/ 发送型号和现场电源。

heading.zh: 喷射混凝土与喷浆的差别

body.en: A motor kilowatt line is not a supply-voltage line. The page does not list a second voltage for the manual setting. The absence is the fact. Send the model plus the site supply through /en/contact/.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台给这台混凝土泵单独的页面。

answer.en: No. Electric 80 lists 110 kW. It does not list a rated voltage. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete.
answer.zh: 没有。电动80标出 110 kW。它不标出额定电压。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 哪台混凝土泵标出 380 V？

answer.en: B500S-83D. The entry is labelled rated voltage. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete.
answer.zh: B500S-83D。这一格的标题是额定电压。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does the manual setting have its own voltage?
question.zh: 手动档有单独的电压吗？

answer.en: The page does not list one. It lists 380 V once, next to 7.5 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete.
answer.zh: 页面没有另标出。它只标出一次 380 V，旁边是 7.5 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is a kilowatt figure a voltage?

answer.en: No. Motor power and rated voltage are different entries. Only one of them is on most electric pages. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete.
answer.zh: 不是。电机功率和额定电压是不同的格子。多数电动页只有其中一项。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shotcrete画面里印出的数字。
